home.title: Free treatment under government schemes — we help you use it
home.lead: Many families in Maharashtra are covered for cashless treatment but do not know it. We help you check your cover, get your papers ready and reach the right hospital.
home.freeNote: Free for patients. We never ask you for money.

steps.title: Check cover
steps.text: We check if you or your family are covered by a government health scheme.

steps.title: Get documents ready
steps.text: We help you get your scheme card and papers ready.

steps.title: Visit the right hospital
steps.text: We help you book a visit at an empanelled hospital and go with you until admission.

home.schemesLead: Short guides in simple words. Always confirm on the official website.
home.campsLead: Meet our team in person. Bring your Aadhaar card and ration card.
home.noCamps: No camps are listed right now. Call or WhatsApp us to ask about the next one.

who.title: Families
who.text: Covered by PM-JAY and Mahatma Phule Jan Arogya Yojana.

who.title: Seniors aged 70+
who.text: Covered by Ayushman Vay Vandana, whatever their income.

who.title: Poor patients
who.text: Who can ask for free or low-cost beds at charitable trust hospitals.

home.moneyTitle: If anyone asks you for money
home.moneyText: Scheme treatment is cashless. We never charge patients. If anyone asks you for money in our name, or a hospital asks for money for scheme treatment, tell us and call the official helpline.
home.ctaText: Leave your number. We will call you back and explain, in Marathi, Hindi or English.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: We walk with you from your first call up to hospital admission. From admission, the hospital takes over.

steps.title: You contact us
steps.text: Call, WhatsApp, fill the form, or meet us at a camp.

steps.title: We check your eligibility
steps.text: We ask a few simple questions and check which scheme covers you.

steps.title: We help with your card and documents
steps.text: If you need a scheme card, we show you how to get one. We tell you which papers to bring.

steps.title: We book an OPD visit
steps.text: We book a visit at an empanelled hospital and tell you how to get there.

steps.title: The doctor advises
steps.text: The hospital doctor examines you. All medical advice comes from the doctor, not from us.

steps.title: You decide
steps.text: You and your family decide what to do. There is no pressure from us.

steps.title: We help you reach admission
steps.text: We help you get the pre-authorisation papers ready and go with you to admission.

how.handoverTitle: From admission, the hospital takes over
how.handoverText: Treatment, discharge and scheme claims are handled by the hospital and the scheme. Our work ends at admission.
how.freeText: Yes. Patients never pay us anything. We are paid by partner hospitals for staff and outreach work, with a fixed fee — never per patient.

schemes.title: Government health schemes
schemes.lead: Simple guides to the main schemes in Maharashtra. Always check the official website or helpline before you go.

pmjay.name: PM-JAY + Mahatma Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
pmjay.short: Cashless treatment up to {coverPerFamily} per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
pmjay.metaTitle: Ayushman card and Mahatma Phule Jan Arogya Yojana help in Pune
pmjay.metaDescription: Free help to check your cover under PM-JAY and MJPJAY in Maharashtra: up to {coverPerFamily} cashless treatment per family per year. Free for patients.
pmjay.intro: In Maharashtra, Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY and the Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana work together as one scheme. It gives cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.
who: Families in Maharashtra. Coverage was extended to all Maharashtra families in {allFamiliesSince}.
You use your Aadhaar card or ration card to show you are covered.
Confirm your own cover on the official website or helpline.
what: Cashless treatment up to {coverPerFamily} per family per year.
About {procedureCount} treatments and operations are included.
You should not pay for scheme treatment at the hospital.
bring: Any doctor's papers you already have
how: Go to an empanelled hospital and meet the scheme desk (Arogya Mitra).
The hospital checks your cover and asks the scheme for approval (pre-authorisation).

faq.q: Do I need a card before going to the hospital?
faq.a: Not always. The hospital's scheme desk can check your cover using your Aadhaar or ration card. We can help you check before you go.

faq.q: Does the hospital decide which treatment I get?
faq.a: Yes. The doctor decides your treatment. The scheme decides what it pays for.

faq.q: What if the hospital asks for money?
faq.a: Scheme treatment is cashless. Call {helplineState} or {helplineNational}, and tell us.

vay.name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (70+)
vay.short: Everyone aged {vayVandanaAge}+ is covered for up to {vayVandanaCover} a year, whatever their income.
vay.metaTitle: Ayushman Vay Vandana card help for seniors 70+ in Pune
vay.metaDescription: Free help for seniors aged 70+ to enrol in Ayushman Vay Vandana: up to {vayVandanaCover} a year, any income. Free for patients.
vay.intro: Ayushman Vay Vandana started on {vayVandanaLaunched}. It covers senior citizens aged {vayVandanaAge} and above.
who: Age is checked from your Aadhaar card.
what: If your family is already covered, the senior gets extra cover for themselves.
bring: Mobile phone linked to Aadhaar (for OTP)
how: Enrol at an empanelled hospital, on the Ayushman app, or on {linkBeneficiary}.
Get your Ayushman Vay Vandana card.
Use it at an empanelled hospital when the doctor advises treatment.

faq.q: My father is 72 and we are not poor. Is he covered?
faq.a: Yes, this scheme does not look at income. Confirm with helpline {helplineNational}.

faq.q: Can a son or daughter do the enrolment?
faq.a: A family member can help. The senior's Aadhaar and the mobile linked to it are needed for OTP.
No. Enrolment is free. We also never charge for helping.

charity.name: Free beds in charitable hospitals
charity.short: Charitable trust hospitals keep {charityFreeBedsPercent} of beds free and {charityConcessionBedsPercent} at low cost for poor patients.
charity.metaTitle: Free and low-cost beds in charitable hospitals, Maharashtra
charity.metaDescription: Charitable trust hospitals in Maharashtra keep {charityFreeBedsPercent} of beds free and {charityConcessionBedsPercent} concessional for poor patients. Free help to ask.
charity.intro: Under the Maharashtra Public Trusts Act and a {charityCourtYear} Bombay High Court ruling, charitable trust hospitals must keep some beds for poor and weaker-section patients.
who: Poor patients and patients from weaker sections.
Income limits apply. The hospital's charity desk checks them.
This is separate from the government insurance schemes.
what: Another {charityConcessionBedsPercent} of beds are at a lower (concessional) rate.
Only at registered charitable trust hospitals.
bring: Any doctor's papers you already have
how: Ask at the hospital's charity or social work desk.
If you have a complaint, contact the Charity Commissioner's office.

faq.q: How do I know if a hospital is a charitable trust hospital?
faq.a: Ask the hospital, or check with the Charity Commissioner's office. We can help you find out.

faq.q: What if the hospital says no free beds are available?
faq.a: Ask for it in writing. You can complain to the Charity Commissioner's office. Tell us and we will guide you.

hospitals.lead: We help empanelled hospitals reach families who are covered but do not use their cover, and we support your scheme desk before admission.

offers.text: NHA-trained Arogya Mitras and coordinators at your hospital: eligibility checks, card help, documents ready for pre-authorisation, handover at admission, and a monthly report. Discharge and claims stay with your own team.

offers.title: Outreach programmes
offers.text: Screening camps, community and senior-citizen talks, enrolment drives, and a phone and WhatsApp helpline — in Marathi and Hindi.

fees: Fixed monthly fee per staff member, or per programme or camp.
Never a fee per patient, admission, procedure or claim.
rules: No clinical role: all medical advice and decisions stay with your doctors.
Our work ends at admission. Treatment, discharge and claims stay with the hospital.
Every enquiry gets a lead ID so monthly reports are clear.
You approve every ad and page about your hospital. No cure claims or guarantees.
We follow the State Health Agency's rules on outreach and camps.

Families do not know which hospital accepts the scheme for their treatment.
Some are wrongly asked to pay.
do: Awareness in the community: camps, talks, self-help groups, ration-shop notices.
Eligibility checks and help with scheme enrolment.
Helping patients reach an empanelled hospital and get to admission.

about.what: We help patients and families check their scheme cover, get their card and documents ready, find an empanelled hospital, book an OPD visit, and reach admission. The hospital handles treatment, discharge and claims.
independence: We are not a government office, not an insurance company and not a hospital.
We do not create scheme cards or touch the scheme's claim system.
We never keep your Aadhaar, ration card or medical documents.
Patients never pay us. Partner hospitals pay a fixed fee for staff and outreach — never per patient.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.metaDescription: Is it really free? Do you work for the government? What documents do I need? Answers in simple words.

items.a: Yes. Free for patients — always. We never ask patients for money for any reason: not for card help, forms, travel or 'processing'.
Partner hospitals pay us a fixed monthly fee for staff and outreach work, and later CSR funders may support our work. We are never paid per patient.

items.q: Do you work for the government?
items.a: No. {business} is an independent organisation. We are not a government agency, not an insurer and not a hospital. Official information is on {linkPmjay} and {linkJeevandayee}.

items.q: Which hospitals do you work with?
items.a: We help you find an empanelled (scheme) hospital for the treatment you need. You can also search for empanelled hospitals on the official websites.

Usually your Aadhaar card, ration card and a mobile phone linked to Aadhaar. Bring any doctor's papers you already have. Please do not send documents in our online form — we will guide you on the phone.

items.q: What if a hospital asks me for money?
items.a: Scheme treatment is cashless. Call the official helpline {helplineNational} or {helplineState}, and tell us.
No. We do not give medical advice. The doctor at the hospital decides your treatment. You decide whether to go ahead.
From admission, the hospital takes over. Treatment, discharge and scheme claims are handled by the hospital.

items.q: Can you guarantee the scheme will approve my treatment?
items.a: No. The scheme decides approval. We help you check and prepare so you are ready.

sections.p: {business} ('we') helps patients use government health schemes. Contact: {email}, {phone}, {address}.

When you fill a form we collect your name, mobile number, district, preferred language, who needs help, the type of help and your preferred callback time. For partner enquiries we collect your organisation and contact details. We also record where you came from (for example a camp QR code or an ad), the date and time of your consent, and the version of this policy.
We do not ask for Aadhaar numbers, ration card numbers, medical reports or diagnoses on this website. Please do not send them. We do not keep copies of your documents.
Only to contact you by phone or WhatsApp about your request, to help you with the scheme process up to admission, and to count our work in reports (as totals, without your name).
With a partner hospital only when you ask us to book a visit there. We never sell your data. We do not send your form answers to advertising or analytics companies.
In a Google Sheet with access limited to our team, and on our phones for WhatsApp messages.
[RETENTION PERIOD — e.g. 12 months after your last contact], then we delete it.
You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data at any time. Contact {email} or {phone}.
We count page visits without cookies. If you accept, we may also use Google Analytics or Meta Pixel to measure our ads. They never receive your form answers.
If we change this policy we update the version number above.
{business} gives free information and help to patients about government health schemes, up to hospital admission.

Schemes, hospitals and government agencies decide eligibility, approval and treatment. We cannot guarantee any outcome.
Scheme rules can change. Always confirm on the official websites and helplines.
